study: Crop-JEPA Stage C: content-guided target placement in I-JEPA on LUCASVision crop photographs (final stage)

hypotheses.H1 (P): veg_pos > ijepa on the primary endpoint
hypotheses.H2 (P): veg_pos > pos_matched (greenness beyond the static veg_pos position prior)
hypotheses.H3 (P): veg_pos > veg_neg (placement polarity matters; replicates Stage B)
hypotheses.H4 (P): neg_matched > veg_neg (veg_neg's deficit is content-driven, beyond its own position prior)
hypotheses.H5 (S): (veg_pos - ijepa) accuracy difference is larger on high-ExG-dispersion test images than on low-dispersion test images

P.confirmed_if: Holm p < 0.05 AND 95% hierarchical-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0

E.equivalent_if: 95% hierarchical-bootstrap CI inside +/- margin (TOST at alpha 0.025 each = Bonferroni over 2)

S.test: H5: exact Wilcoxon signed-rank, one-sided (greater), on per-seed (high - low) stratum differences
S.confirmed_if: p < 0.05 AND seed-bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0

R.what: replication summary: veg_pos - ijepa per setting (core, splitB, vits) pooled by DerSimonian-Laird random effects (pooled estimate, 95% CI, I^2); the bridge phase is pooled with Stage B seeds 0-5
R.status: reported as a summary; no confirmatory claim beyond families P, E and S

exploratory: mid tertile and other moderation pairs
Stage B 160 px vs DINOv2 ViT-S/14 224 px reference

primary_endpoint.evaluation: logistic-regression probe on frozen target-encoder mean-pooled features, C chosen on validation macro-F1
primary_endpoint.aggregation: mean over label draws, then over regimes; unit = pretraining seed

moderator.definition: D(x) = population std (ddof=0) of the 10x10 patch chromatic-ExG map of the evaluation view (cache resized to img_size)
moderator.strata: tertiles; cut points from the TRAIN images of the split
moderator.statistic: per seed: accuracy over the primary regimes and all draws, per stratum; H5 = (acc_veg_pos - acc_ijepa | high) - (acc_veg_pos - acc_ijepa | low)

token_budget.rule: adopt the fixed budget K (protocol C) if capped online k-NN val F1 >= uncapped - 3 pp AND capped final RankMe >= 20 AND no non-finite steps; otherwise keep Stage B's per-batch equalisation (protocol B)

splitB.role: replication R1: H1-H4 on a new group-aware split (Holm within phase)

vits.role: replication R3: H1 with ViT-S/16 at 160 px

bridge.role: exploratory: Stage B protocol (no cap, 9,030 steps) on fresh seeds; pooled with Stage B seeds 0-5

decision_matrix.P-A: H1 Holm p < 0.05 AND 95% CI lower bound > 0 AND estimate >= +0.5 pp -> 'vegetation-aware target placement improves I-JEPA'
decision_matrix.P-A': H1 Holm p < 0.05 AND 95% CI lower bound > 0 BUT estimate < +0.5 pp -> 'statistically reliable but below the SESOI'
decision_matrix.P-B: veg_pos - ijepa 90% CI inside (-1.0, +1.0) pp (TOST, alpha 0.05) -> 'equivalent to uniform placement on average'
decision_matrix.P-D: veg_pos - ijepa 95% CI upper bound < 0 AND exact Wilcoxon p (less) < 0.05 -> 'vegetation guidance is harmful'
decision_matrix.P-C: none of the above -> 'inconclusive; effect bounded to the reported 95% CI'
decision_matrix.polarity: H3 confirmed AND H4 confirmed -> veg_neg's deficit is content-driven (beyond its spatial distribution); H3 confirmed, H4 not confirmed, veg_neg - neg_matched 95% CI inside +/-1.0 pp -> the deficit is explained by where veg_neg puts its targets; otherwise -> polarity mechanism unresolved
decision_matrix.spatial_prior: E1 equivalent -> a static spatial prior does not change representations (replicates Stage B)
decision_matrix.moderation: H5 exact Wilcoxon p (greater) < 0.05 AND bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0 -> benefit larger on heterogeneous scenes

bootstrap.scheme: resample seeds -> label draws within seed -> test images (shared by arms)

exclusions: a run that crashes twice is excluded for ALL arms of that seed in that phase (list-wise); never by results
compute_shortfall: if compute runs out, the core is analysed at the largest number of complete seeds (>= 12), decided before any statistics are computed
